# Argo CD threat model  Argo CD is a declarative GitOps continuous delivery tool for Kubernetes. It watches Git, Helm and OCI repositories, renders Kubernetes manifests from them, and syncs those manifests into one or more Kubernetes clusters. It holds credentials for those clusters and for the repositories, so a flaw can lead to cluster takeover or credential theft across many environments.
